claim: A disposable, zero-credit R-005 route qualification can reach the unchanged destination [140,31,0] in the preserved McWilliams world through the materially different east-flank geography, without undeclared threat handling or drift of the player, ecology actors, scheduler inputs, lifecycle gates, or destination.
material_proof: One explicitly selected run starts from the preserved bandit_r005_natural_hostile_ecology_v0 copy and proves its bound world, player, exact ecology actor identities, scheduler inputs, and lifecycle gates before native travel. It uses ordinary overmap routing on the east-flank geography—first [140,41,0] to [141,40,0], then [141,40,0] to [141,31,0], then [141,31,0] to [140,31,0]—and records native route construction, travel progress, every threat prompt and its declared resolution, destination arrival, binding comparison, report ingestion, and accepted cleanup beneath a fresh disposable run directory. This qualification has zero certification credit; it only establishes whether the east-flank route reaches the remaining-path-one boundary without an undeclared threat or identity/scheduler/destination/lifecycle drift.
material_contradiction: a preserved-binding preflight finds a changed world, player, ecology actor, scheduler input, destination, or lifecycle gate
a required east-flank leg cannot be constructed by ordinary native overmap routing
an undeclared threat prompt, combat action, replacement identity, scheduler change, destination change, or lifecycle drift occurs before arrival
the run cannot reach [140,31,0] with a bound native arrival receipt
the run changes the fixture or scenario, uses a replay or checkpoint rollback, or cleanup is not accepted
already_accepted_evidence: Preserved zero-credit counterexample report 1115bdc9790c943d59fed8563974ba651b1dd977d3e835bda5e99114ccd0e299 and verification e437bc7ae93a923f85aae0ff66fe4554f9e983031c039ef9f2f38a9c291fb9c7 show that the west flank encountered a different hostile survivor before arrival. The prompt received no response and that route cannot qualify under the declared actor boundary.

The R-005 scenario declares McWilliams, bandit_r005_natural_hostile_ecology_v0, the preserved player save, the two-actor hostile ecology lifecycle, destination [140,31,0], and fail-closed native travel stabilization.
current_uncertainty: The east-flank geography is unqualified. It is materially different from the failed west flank, but it must still prove each preserved precondition and native destination arrival before certification may begin.
